info.title: {product_name} machine API (ai-api v1)
info.description: Signed, scoped, idempotent machine API. AI keys are ASK-ONLY: they read summaries and make proposals; only a signed-in human decides. Generated from src/aiapi.js by scripts/make-openapi.js. See CONTRACT/ai-api-v1.md.

post.summary: Ask for something (ASK-ONLY: nothing happens until a human decides)
post.description: Creates a pending proposal and answers HTTP 202 {status:"pending_human"}. Nothing is executed. Allowed ops: event.submit, event.approve, event.reject, reward.award, reward.reverse, ratecard.change, target.change, penalty.propose, penalty.rule.change. Only a signed-in human admin can accept or reject it; on accept only event.submit is carried out (through the normal intake pipeline with its own approvals and caps), every other op is recorded as approved for a person to carry out in the admin screen. Proposals expire after 7 days. Free text is stored as data (length limited) and never interpreted. This call itself moves no credits (x-money false); the ops it can ask for are flagged in x-proposal-ops. Penalty proposals are board points or steps only: any pay, wages, salary or credit-deduction penalty is refused with penalty_points_only.

keyId.name: X-Key-Id
keyId.description: The key id (fk_...). Keys are made by the company admin. Key classes: read, event_write, manager, admin (each includes the ones before it), ai_read (separate, ask-only), provider_webhook (separate).

timestamp.name: X-Timestamp
timestamp.description: Milliseconds since 1970 (UTC). Must be within 5 minutes of the server.

signature.name: X-Signature
signature.description: hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, '<timestamp>.<METHOD> <pathAndQuery>.<rawBody>'). A signature works once.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every write. 8 to 100 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 _ : . - . Same key and same body replays the stored answer (header idempotent-replayed: true). Same key with a different body is idempotency_conflict.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes. Meaning: unsigned (401): The signed headers are missing. bad_signature (401): The signature was not accepted. stale_timestamp (401): The timestamp is too old or too new (5 minute window). replayed (401): This exact signed request was already used. rate_limited (429): Too many calls this minute for this key class. scope_denied (403): This key class may not call this route. ai_off (403): AI access is switched off (company setting or platform switch). hub_off (503): The Hub has switched this product off. hub_read_only (503): The Hub has made this product read-only. Writes are refused. hub_unreachable (503): The Hub status file could not be read. AI keys and writes fail closed. hub_action_disabled (503): The Hub has disabled this action. idempotency_required (400): Writes need an Idempotency-Key header of 8 to 100 characters (A-Z a-z 0-9 _ : . -). idempotency_conflict (409): This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body. idempotency_in_progress (409): A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. validation (400): The request is not valid. bad_json (400): The body is not valid JSON. too_big (413): The request is too large. not_found (404): Not found. duplicate (409): The same request is already pending. penalty_points_only (422): Penalties are board points or steps only. Never pay, wages, salary or a credit deduction. internal (500): Something went wrong on our side.
